chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn 'Amir narrated to me from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad al-Basri, who said: He narrated to me from Ibn Sadaqah, from al-Mufaddal ibn 'Umar, who said:

Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'I swear to Allah, it is as if I see the angels crowding around the believers at the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him).' I asked: 'Do they appear for him?' He replied: 'Far, far from it! I swear to Allah, they are attached to the believers, to the extent that they wipe their faces with their hands.'

And Allah sends down to the visitors of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), morning and evening, from the food of Paradise, and the angels are their servants. Any servant of Allah who asks Allah for any need of this world or the Hereafter, He will grant it to him.
I said: 'This, I swear to Allah, is the honour.' He said to me: 'O Mufaddal, shall I add to it?' I said: 'Yes, O my master.'

He said: 'It is as if I see a throne made of light that has been placed, and a dome made of a red ruby, adorned with gems, has been erected over it. And it is as if I see al-Husayn (peace be upon him) sitting on that throne, and around him are ninety thousand green domes.'

And it is as if I see the believers visiting him and sending him greetings. Then Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will say to them: 'O My friends! Ask Me, for you have been hurt, humiliated, and oppressed for a long time. So this is the day that you will not ask Me for any need of this world or the Hereafter without Me fulfilling it for you.'
So their eating and drinking will be in Paradise. This, I swear to Allah, is the honour which has no end and whose limit cannot be reached.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards and angelic presence for those who visit the grave of Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: In *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Ibn Qulawayh records Imam al-Sadiq’s vivid eschatological vision where angels cling to visitors of Imam al-Husayn, symbolizing the intimate connection between the Ahl al-Bayt and their devotees. This narration underscores the theological concept of *al-Karamah al-Husayniyyah*, where intercession and divine favor are directly linked to the martyr’s legacy, offering believers both worldly needs and eternal sustenance in Paradise as recompense for their historical oppression.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. Ḥusain ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Āmir narrated to me from Mu’allā ibn Muḥammad Al-Basri, from Abil Faďl, from (Musaddiq) ibn Sadaqah, from Mufaďďal ibn ‘Umar, who said:

Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said, “I swear to Allāh that it is as if I can see a crowd of angels around the believers next to the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.).” I asked, “Do they appear for the believers?” Imam (a.s.) replied, “Impossible! Impossible! (But) I swear to Allāh that they are attached to the believers and they touch their faces with their hands.

Every morning and every night, Allāh sends down food for the Zuwwār of Ḥusain (a.s.) from Paradise and the angels are their servants. If they ask Allāh for any matter related to this life or the Hereafter, Allāh will grant it to them.”
I said, “I swear to Allāh that this is the (great) honour.” Imam (a.s.) said, “O Mufaďďal! Should I tell you more?” I replied, “Yes, O my master.”

Imam (a.s.) said: It is as if I can see a throne made of light which has been established. A dome made of a red ruby and decorated with gems has been placed on it and there are ninety thousand green domes surrounding it. And it is as if I can see Ḥusain (a.s.) sitting on this throne

and the believers are going to his Ziyārah and saying Salām to him. Therefore, Allāh, the Great and Almighty, will say to them, “O My friends! Ask Me (anything) because you have been hurt, humiliated, and oppressed for a long time. However, today is the day that you will not ask Me for anything related to this life or the Hereafter without it being granted.”
Imam (a.s.) added: Their food and drinks are in Paradise, and I swear to Allāh that this is the honour which will never end and its greatness cannot be perceived.
